selection_summary.selection_criterion: Validation max specificity subject to fake recall >= 0.90

validation_comparison.note: All models evaluated on identical validation set (902 videos: 107 real, 795 fake)

test_set_evaluation.disclosure: Official test set evaluated ONCE after freezing model and threshold. Test set was NOT used for threshold selection or model selection. However, the same official test list has been used in prior experiments; no truly independent test set reserved.

YouTube_real.note: Videos have numeric filenames only; no identity information

domain_bias_analysis.finding: Model learns domain features (Celeb vs YouTube) rather than manipulation artifacts
evidence: Celeb-real and Celeb-synthesis probability distributions overlap heavily
Video properties (frames, fps, resolution) similar between false positives and true negatives
domain_bias_analysis.impact: Celeb-real false positive rate 84.3% at threshold 0.66 vs YouTube-real 28.6%
domain_bias_analysis.limitation: Results reflect dataset/source differences, not general deepfake manipulation detection

costs: Fake recall: -0.0353 (0.9529 -> 0.9176 on test), still meets >=0.90 requirement
unresolved: Celeb-real domain bias persists (84.3% FPR at threshold 0.66)
Model does not generalize to unseen Celeb identities (identity-disjoint test balanced_acc=0.603)
YouTube-real has no identity metadata for controlled evaluation
Results are dataset-specific; not generalizable to arbitrary deepfake videos

production_readiness.reason: Model detects domain features (Celeb vs YouTube) rather than manipulation artifacts. Performance on Celeb-real is poor (15.7% accuracy). Not suitable for production without additional domain-diverse training data.
production_readiness.recommended_use: Research/academic evaluation only with clear documentation of limitations
deployment_requirements: Collect additional datasets (FaceForensics++, DFDC) for domain-diverse training
Calibrate threshold on target deployment domain data
Reserve truly independent test set for final evaluation

final_recommendation.use_case: Academic research / controlled evaluation on Celeb-DF-v2
final_recommendation.not_recommended_for: Production deployment without significant additional work
next_steps: Train domain-invariant model with adversarial domain adaptation
Reserve independent test set for final evaluation
